notes.title: New Hide & Seek Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33821028/1cff4846bf043a4efd7902b5b765b8bf30365958.png[/img]
Boomerang Fu has just sold over 1 million copies! Thank you to all of you who have played our little couch game and shared the laughs with your friends and family.

To celebrate, we're releasing a new update to Boomerang Fu today that includes a brand new "Hide & Seek" game mode. We hope you’ll find it equal parts tense and ridiculous.

[h1][b]Update 1.3.1 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]HIDE AND SEEK MODE[/b][/h2]
Scramble to find the perfect hiding spot or hunt down your friends in this tense new game mode.

Each player gets a turn as the seeker and closes their eyes while everyone else hides. After 10 seconds, the hiders transform into nearby props and the seeker has to figure out which bamboo is real and which is a donut in disguise.

The time limit and number of seek attempts can be changed in the Modifiers menu for people who want an easier or harder hide and seek experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33821028/9cec02325f913c0dc823e6828d4f37da000468dc.png[/img]
[h2][b]FALL PROTECTION[/b][/h2]
Are you tired of stumbling into the water by accident? Fall Protection is our brand new accessibility setting aimed at younger players and people who just want to throw boomerangs without worrying about walking off cliffs.

You can now find Fall Protection in the Modifiers menu. It has 3 settings: 
[list]
[*]Off: the classic Boomerang Fu experience
[*]Gentle: subtly nudge players away from edges (default)
[*]Extreme: completely stop players walking off edges
[/list]
[h2][b]NEW MUSIC[/b][/h2]
Two new tracks have been added to the match playlist: "Just Desserts" by Paul Kopetko and "Hide and Seek" by Zorsy.

[h2][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]When new characters are unlocked, they are highlighted in the Choose Characters screen
[*]Bamboozled is never the first powerup collected in a match, so new players don't get confused by what the books do
[*]Died out of bounds with your hat on? Now your hat stays behind so you can see what happened more easily.
[/list]
[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]FIXED: bots had trouble navigating on and off floating platforms
[*]FIXED: frozen decoys sometimes left hats behind on the playfield
[*]FIXED: jittery collision with moving obstacles
[*]FIXED: occasional wonky controller assignment in the Pause menu
[*]FIXED: invisible colliders in two levels
[*]FIXED: using teleport boomerangs or portals could extinguish players on fire too soon
[/list]

notes.title: New Options and Languages in Update 1.0.6!
notes.content:
Thanks for a fantastic launch week, everyone! We're beyond excited that so many people have enjoyed slicing and dicing their friends with boomerangs already. We got some great feedback from the Boomerang Fu community, so here's a whole bunch of new options and languages by popular demand!

[h1][b]Update 1.0.6 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]NEW OPTIONS:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added [b]Key Bindings[/b] menu to Options to let you configure custom keys. If you hate WASD + JKL, you’ll LOVE this!
[*] Added an option to the Team Up menu to [b]make all bots join Team Chill[/b]. Recreate your favourite Terminator movies by fighting a team of 5 hard mode bots all by yourself!
[*] Added [b]"disable slow mo"[/b] to Options menu. A lot of people requested this and I can only assume they thought Boomerang Fu wasn’t fast-paced enough.
[*] Moved "save replay" folder from Desktop to My Documents due to popular demand. Apparently I’m the only one who mainly uses their Desktop as a gif storage facility. Who knew!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33821028/62365202d041fa8d071506dcd439473dd97237b3.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]NEW LANGUAGES:[/b][/h2]
Added fan translations for:
[list]
[b][*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Turkish
[*] Polish[/b]
[/list]
Many thanks to our wonderful Discord community translators for their efforts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33821028/fefcae3eecb8cadce0d6b9c06e13c193e3f56ed3.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]BALANCE TWEAKS:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Power-ups spawn 20% less often per power-up already collected. This is to avoid big power-up stacks in the early game.
[*] Power-ups spawn less often if fewer power-ups are enabled in Custom power-ups. This is to avoid everyone having the exact same stack early in the game.
[*] Reduced the revive time in Team Up mode so it's a little easier to resurrect your fallen comrades
[*] Players can now only steal a boomerang off a dead teammate’s body if the dead body is holding two boomerangs. This is to prevent you accidentally disarming your teammate while you're reviving them.
[*] Rotated Big Island level a little to make it more aesthetically pleasing.
[/list]

[h2][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the ironically broken “Ice Breaker” match award and achievement 
[*] Disabling Bamboozled power-up in custom power-ups menu actually disables it now
[*] Fixed custom power-up selection getting mixed up in Golden Boomerang mode
[*] Removed Dash Through Walls power-up in Golden Boomerang mode
[*] Fixed players with Dash Through Walls be able to hide in garden beds in Pier and Temple levels
[*] Fixed rare cases where one power-up could be collected by two people at once
[*] Fixed z-fighting when milk and coffee get spilled in the same place. We fight with Boomerangs, not Zs.
[*] D-pad on dual grip Joycons and Switch Pro Controller can now navigate the Lobby
[*] Players with disconnected controllers now get kicked from the lobby
[/list]

notes.title: Boomerang Fu - Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h2][b]Slice and dice your friends on August 13th![/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=kRy73T2RlwE;full][/previewyoutube]
Boomerang Fu, the frantic boomerang brawler starring adorable yet lethal food creatures, invites up to six local players to duke it out on Steam, Nintendo Switch and Xbox One on [b]August 13th 2020[/b].

Select one of 12 unlockable food characters from the mighty Milk Carton to the awesome Avocado, then leave a delightful mess by tearing each other apart in fast-paced food fights. Learn the simple controls in minutes, then deftly dash away from danger and unleash a barrage of bladed boomerangs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33821028/105484b6ea633076dd0c9590d7050b3290753f88.jpg[/img]

Power up boomerangs with flames, frost, or explosives to obliterate opponents, then take it a step further with telekinesis, multi boomerangs, or teleportation. Learn how each of the twelve power-ups work, find a spectacularly ridiculous combo and destroy the competition. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33821028/0d117ca4453ced873f8f12f3fd51f7aa70406ae3.png[/img]

Try playing with your Steam friends online using Remote Play Together on Steam. The video quality and input lag may vary depending on your internet connection, but some players are getting excellent results.

Get a taste for the finer things with the FREE Boomerang Fu Demo, available for a short time during the Steam Game Festival, Summer Edition.

[previewyoutube=XuaNC1cIsUs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's in this demo?[/h2]

The Boomerang Fu Demo contains the same fast-paced physics action you know and love, but it's limited to 6 playable food characters, 6 spectacular power-ups, and the standard free-for-all game mode.

We hope you'll love this little entrée to Boomerang Fu. So if you do, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/965680/][b]wishlist Boomerang Fu[/b][/url] after you've sliced and diced your friends.

The full game is coming VERY soon with 12 characters, 12 power-ups, 3 game modes, adjustable modifiers and over 30 deadly arenas.

You can use the Remote Play Together feature here on Steam to try playing Boomerang Fu with your Steam friends online. The video quality and input lag may vary depending on your internet connection, but hey, the demo is free, so why not give it a go? Only one player needs to download the demo to host a session.

notes.title: Boomerang Fu is in the PAX 10!
notes.content:
Boomerang Fu is coming to PAX West which starts on Friday in Seattle, USA! If you're there, come to booth 7316 and play a few rounds of Boomerang Fu, meet our jet-lagged art director, Julian, and buy a cute character pin from our little merch stand.

We’re honoured to be selected for the PAX 10, which is a showcase of the 10 best indie games of the year as chosen by a mysterious panel of 50 industry experts.

Here are the other amazing games in the PAX 10 this year:

[list]


[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/596970/SUNLESS_SKIES/]Sunless Skies[/url] is a Gothic Horror RPG with a focus on exploration and exquisite storytelling for Windows, Mac and Linux

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11789502/7d0723b639b1c3095312f0eabb46d6157c19e159.png[/img]

We’re really excited to be showing our cute little fighting game next to such weird and wonderful titles from around the world. Hopefully we'll get to meet a few of you there!

Stay juicy,

Cranky Watermelon
